units.source_text: 千重子自从跟龙助、真一兄弟两人上大市以后，时不时心神恍惚，虽然还不算是极度痛苦。

en.t: Ever since Chieko went to the grand market with the brothers Ryusuke and Shinichi, she had been absent-minded from time to time, though it was not yet a matter of extreme suffering.

units.source_text: 她自己似乎也注意到了，这也许是烦恼的缘故吧。

en.t: She herself seemed to have noticed it too; perhaps it was because of her worries.
